name: hoomuch
description: All your subscription revenue under one roof — Stripe, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, RevenueCat, Chargebee, Dodo Payments, Gumroad, Adapty, Superwall.

scripts.build: npm run css && npm run js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 32 random bytes, base64. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`. **Back it up:** if it's lost, every stored provider key becomes unreadable. Never rotate it in place.

ALLOW_SIGNUP.description: Leave `true` until you've created your own account, then set it to `false` so nobody else can sign up on your instance.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Optional. A Cloudflare Turnstile site key. With `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` set too, log in and sign up require the Turnstile check. Leave empty to keep it off.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Optional secret. The secret key of the same Turnstile widget.

MAIL_FROM.description: Optional. Sender of the sign-up confirmation email, on a domain verified in Resend, e.g. `hoomuch <hello@example.com>`. Needed once `RESEND_API_KEY` is set.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional secret. A Resend API key with sending access. When set, new accounts must confirm their email address before using hoomuch. Leave empty to keep it off.
